new_scholarship.description: The SUTD Trailblazers (International) Scholarship is a Singapore University of Technology and Design tuition award for high-performing incoming undergraduates who are Singapore Permanent Residents or international students. It covers the subsidised tuition fees, after the Singapore Government Tuition Grant, for the normal duration of the relevant bachelor's degree programme, up to four years. Applicants must apply for the scholarship at the same time as their SUTD admission application, are shortlisted and then assessed in competition by a selection committee whose decision is final, and must take up the Tuition Grant Scheme to enjoy the subsidised fee rate. Recipients must maintain good academic standing reviewed every term, complete at least 20 hours of service to the University, and are exposed to a case-by-case repayment if they terminate the scholarship prematurely.
new_scholarship.best_fit: Incoming SUTD undergraduates, whether Singapore Permanent Residents or international students, who hold outstanding GCE A level, Local Polytechnic Diploma, NUS High School Diploma, IB Diploma or Year 12 equivalent results, have a strong record of co-curricular or community activity, and can show leadership potential. Because awards are made in competition and SUTD reserves the right to award nothing if no candidate shows sufficient merit, it should be treated as a merit award pursued alongside admission rather than a guaranteed funding route.

new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Open to Singapore Permanent Residents and international students applying for admission to a SUTD undergraduate degree programme who hold outstanding Singapore-Cambridge GCE A level, Local Polytechnic Diploma, NUS High School Diploma, IB Diploma or Year 12 equivalent qualifications, demonstrate strong leadership capability and potential, possess an excellent record of co-curricular and/or community activities, and show the attitude, desire and potential to make an impact to society. Applicants must submit the scholarship application at the same time as the SUTD admission application. To enjoy the subsidised fee rate the recipient must take up the Tuition Grant Scheme from the Singapore Government. Recipients must maintain good academic standing, which is reviewed every term, must complete at least 20 hours of service to the University, and may not hold any other scholarship or grant concurrently without the University's approval.

The recipient must take up the Tuition Grant Scheme (TGS) from the Singapore Government to enjoy the subsidised fees the Scholarship covers; the subsidised rate is therefore conditional on a government scheme, not solely on the university award.
The recipient is required to achieve and maintain good academic standing, and academic performance is reviewed every term.

The recipient is required to complete at least 20 hours of service to the University, taking on roles such as student ambassador or any similar role, representing SUTD to give publicity talks and to receive guests, as and when called upon to do so.
The recipient may not, without the approval of the University, hold concurrently any other scholarships or grants.

Awards are competitive and SUTD reserves the right not to award any scholarship where there are no candidates of sufficient merit.

programme_detail_official.description: The SUTD Trailblazers (International) Scholarship is a Singapore University of Technology and Design tuition award for high-performing incoming undergraduates who are Singapore Permanent Residents or international students. It covers the subsidised tuition fees, after the Singapore Government Tuition Grant, for the normal duration of the relevant bachelor's degree programme, up to four years. Applicants must apply for the scholarship at the same time as their SUTD admission application, are shortlisted, and are then considered in competition by a selection committee whose decision is final. Recipients must take up the Tuition Grant Scheme to enjoy the subsidised rate, must maintain good academic standing reviewed every term, must complete at least 20 hours of service to the University, may not hold other awards without approval, and are exposed to a case-by-case repayment if they terminate the scholarship prematurely.
programme_detail_official.program_type: University tuition-fee remission (full subsidised tuition after government Tuition Grant)
programme_detail_official.coverage: Covers the subsidised tuition fees, after the Singapore Government Tuition Grant, for the normal duration of the bachelor's degree programme at SUTD, up to four years. Does not cover living costs, accommodation, travel or any non-tuition charge, and no bond is attached to the scholarship itself.

application_readiness_checklist: Apply to SUTD for admission and signal the scholarship in the same submission, because the scholarship application is made at the same time as the admission application and there is no separate later round.

Have your secondary or pre-university qualification ready in a form SUTD recognises: Singapore-Cambridge GCE A level, Local Polytechnic Diploma, NUS High School Diploma, IB Diploma or Year 12 equivalent.

Build the co-curricular and community record the award actually selects on, since the page names an excellent record in co-curricular and/or community activities as an explicit eligibility condition alongside leadership.
Be ready to evidence leadership capability and potential in your application, which is a named eligibility condition rather than a tie-breaker.
Understand that taking up the Singapore Government Tuition Grant Scheme is a condition of the subsidised fee rate, so you must be willing to enter that scheme.
Budget separately for living costs, accommodation, travel and non-tuition costs, because the award enumerates subsidised tuition only.

Accept the recipient obligations before you count on the award: maintain good academic standing every term, complete at least 20 hours of University service, and do not hold another scholarship or grant without approval.
Plan for the possibility of no award at all, because SUTD reserves the right not to award any scholarship if there are no candidates of sufficient merit.
common_rejection_risks: Lodging the scholarship application separately from, or after, the admission application; the award is considered as part of the admission submission.
Academic results that are not outstanding against the named qualification types, which is the first named eligibility condition.
A thin co-curricular or community record, or an application that does not evidence leadership capability and potential.
Being unwilling or ineligible to take up the Tuition Grant Scheme, which is what gives the recipient the subsidised fee rate the scholarship covers.
Failing to maintain good academic standing after award, which is reviewed every term and can result in withdrawal of the scholarship.
Holding another scholarship or grant without prior University approval, which is a breach of the recipient terms.
Terminating the scholarship or enrolment prematurely, which exposes the recipient to a repayment imposed on a case-by-case basis.
Expecting a living allowance: the published benefits enumerate subsidised tuition only, so living costs are not met.
estimated_uncovered_costs: All living costs for the duration of the degree: food, local transport, utilities, phone and internet.
Accommodation, whether in SUTD residence halls or private housing; no accommodation component is published in the award benefits.
Overseas student pass, medical screening and insurance costs for international students.
Air travel to and from Singapore for international students, and any pre-arrival costs.
Course materials, software, laboratory or project consumables, and equipment.
Any non-tuition student levy or miscellaneous fee, since the award enumerates subsidised tuition only.
Any English language testing cost, should your admission route require a test score; no score or reimbursement is published.
The subsidised fee premium, if for any reason the Tuition Grant Scheme is not taken up or is not granted, in which case the scholarship's coverage basis does not apply.
document_audit: The official award page publishes no document checklist for this scholarship, so there is no published list to audit against; do not assume a standard SUTD document set applies to the scholarship itself.
Admission application to a SUTD undergraduate degree programme, submitted together with the scholarship application.

submission_workflow: Choose a SUTD undergraduate degree programme and check that your secondary or pre-university qualification is one SUTD recognises for this scholarship.
Assemble evidence of your results and of your co-curricular, community and leadership record.
Submit the SUTD admission application with the scholarship application made at the same time.
If shortlisted, respond and provide whatever SUTD requests at that stage.
On award, take up the Singapore Government Tuition Grant Scheme to obtain the subsidised fee rate the scholarship covers.
Sign up for and complete at least 20 hours of University service, such as the student ambassador role.
Maintain good academic standing each term so the award is not withdrawn, and confirm before accepting any other scholarship or grant.

research_notes.substitution: Substituted the assigned slot b134 row 'Universiti Sains Malaysia International Undergraduate Scholarships' (host usm.my, Malaysia) for the SUTD Trailblazers (International) Scholarship, which is the assigned slot b131 row 'SUTD Undergraduate Scholarships' (host sutd.edu.sg, Singapore, bachelor eligible, unclaimed by any other agent in research/bachelor at the time of writing). Reason for substituting: Universiti Sains Malaysia publishes no bachelor's-level scholarship or waiver for international students; the only thing it publishes for them is a tuition-fee schedule. Evidence gathered on USM's own domains on 2026-10-03 before substituting: (1) https://admission.usm.my/index.php/undergraduate/undergraduate-international, the official international undergraduate landing page, has exactly four tabs, Programmes, How To Apply, Fees and Download, with no scholarship or financial-aid section at all; (2) its Fees tab at https://admission.usm.my/index.php/undergraduate/undergraduate-international/fee-ugi serves only a single document, UNDERGRADUATE_INTERNATIONAL_TUITION_FEES_PER_SEMESTER.pdf (dated 2025-09-02), i.e. a per-semester tuition fee schedule and not a scholarship; (3) its Download tab at https://admission.usm.my/index.php/undergraduate/undergraduate-international/downloadugi lists only ACADEMIC_CALENDAR.pdf, BOOKLET_INTERNATIONAL_2025-2026.pdf, BROCHURE.pdf, PROSPECTUS_FOR_FIRST_DEGREE_2025-2026.pdf, REGISTRATION_GUIDELINES_FOR_NEW_UNDERGRADUATE_STUDENTS.pdf and SUMMARY_OF_PROGRAMME.pdf, none of which is a scholarship scheme; (4) https://www.usm.my/en/?catid=2&id=24%3Aadmission-v2&view=article, the official USM 'Admission to USM' page updated 24 September 2026, lists 'Financial Assistances ... For International Students' as exactly three schemes, Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS), Commonwealth Scholarship and Fellowship Plan (CSFP) and Islamic Development Bank (IDB) Scholarship, all of which are postgraduate-level external schemes rather than a USM bachelor's scholarship, and it publishes no amount or deadline for any of them; (5) https://pohon.usm.my/t_international.php, the official POHON@USM international applicant portal page, carries no scholarship provision at all. There is also no USM-administered undergraduate scholarship for international students: the only USM undergraduate awards located were corporate or foundation schemes restricted to Malaysian students, such as the Gamuda Scholarship 2026 and the Kuok Foundation Scholarships, both explicitly limited to Malaysian students. The replacement award was verified directly on sutd.edu.sg, the awarding body's own domain, and is a genuine tuition-fee remission covering subsidised tuition fees for the normal duration of a bachelor's degree, not a fee table. Singapore is an allowed region and sutd.edu.sg has no entry in EXISTING_AWARDS.json, and row b131 is unclaimed, so this substitution adds a new, verified, bachelor's-level international award. This file has been renamed from b134-universiti-sains-malaysia-international-undergraduate-scholarships.json to b134-sutd-trailblazers-international-scholarship.json accordingly.
